newsitem.title: USA: Medical Asset has added 8 practices.
newsitem.headline: Medical Asset has added 8 practices.

text.p: Medical Asset Management Inc said it has developed equity affiliations with eight physician practices involving 12 physicians in six states since the beginning of 1997 that provide for management of the practices by Medical Asset.
In addition, the company said, it has agreements or commitments for similar equity affiliations with 10 additional practices involving 13 physicians in six states.

At the end of 1996, the company noted, it had equity affiliations with 28 practices with 48 physicians, as compared to 20 practices and 28 physicians at the end of 1995. In addition, as of December 31, 1995, the company had long term management service contracts with three medical group practices having a total of 44 physicians in two states.

Medical Asset also said it has experienced delays in closing its financial records for 1996 and, accordingly, for the first quarter of 1997. The company said it expects audited 1996 results and unaudited results for the first quarter of 1997 may be available by June 30.
